name: gp-language-pack-server
description: Generates and serves language pack downloads from GlotPress translations via the WordPress REST API.

scripts.zip: wp-scripts plugin-zip && mkdir -p deploy && mv gp-language-pack-server.zip deploy/
scripts.release: npm run update-version && npm run make-pot && npm run zip
scripts.betarelease: npm run update-version && npm run make-pot && npm run zip
